what: pdf-probe v1 vs v2 over the committed chain; v2 gate per link; v1-accepted pdf-probe items re-judged under v2

classes.worse>1pt: |d| grew by more than 1 pt under v2 (the v2 gate fails on it)
classes.within1pt-worse: |d| grew by at most 1 pt (v2 gate: unchanged, counted withinTolerance)
classes.unpaired-after: under v2 the link's word has no Chrome partner within 36 pt on its page
classes.unpaired-before: the Chrome word the link's word pairs with under v2 was unpaired in the compared link
classes.unmapped: the v1 key's vellora word could not be identified as exactly one PyMuPDF word
